claims.claim: Repeat HIV assessment is essential for safe oral-PrEP use
claims.applicability_limit: Oral PrEP only; a negative result may not exclude very recent infection

claims.claim: Published 2023 Indonesian oral-PrEP guidance repeats HIV tests at month three and then every three months
claims.applicability_limit: A separate month-one clinical follow-up exists; not universal schedule for injectable PrEP

claims.claim: STI screening is encouraged in oral-PrEP care
claims.applicability_limit: Recommended, not universally required to begin PrEP

claims.claim: Creatinine tests are conditional, not a universal prerequisite to initiating oral PrEP
claims.applicability_limit: Does not imply that renal testing is never indicated; age, renal disease and comorbidities matter

claims.claim: Routine follow-up supports discussions of adverse effects, adherence and next tests
claims.applicability_limit: Clinical decisions must be individualized by qualified providers

claims.claim: CWC offers DM-based information/navigation for people in Manado
claims.applicability_limit: Navigation only; no named clinic, medicine stock, service availability, price, booking or clinical outcome guaranteed
